messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick sync — we're aiming to push the new pricing slab + micro-estimator on Tue. Need final microcopy for the calculator, two tier-name variants for the page, FAQ deltas, webinar blurb, and inbound routing rules. Who can own which part?
Ravi Patel: I can take tier names + FAQ edits. I want to test: descriptive vs. outcome-led names. e.g., 'Starter — 100k tokens' vs 'Productivity — for light ML infra'.
Ben Gomez: I’ll own the calculator microcopy and the event/webinar blurb. Can we keep the calculator copy <140 chars? It gets truncated in some embeds.
Sam Lee: I’ll do visual microcopy tweaks and QA for truncation. Also can mock the small tooltip copy for KV cache/gap explanation.
Jordana Park: Routing question — for leads generated by the estimator, we should tag as "estimator-prospect" and route to AM pool 2 for demo invites. Ops, can the marketing bot attach UTM + tag? @marketing-bot you up?
marketing-bot: deploy queued: add_lead_tag(estimator-prospect) -> send_to_queue(AM_pool_2). Please confirm schema matches CRM.
Aisha Khan: Confirmed. @Ravi, please prioritize FAQ Qs about SLA and dedicated capacity pricing. Keep answers short — 2 bullets max.
Ravi Patel: Draft FAQ bullets: 1) "What's included in Dedicated? — Reserved GPU capacity, predictable throughput, monthly commit." 2) "Can I bring my model? — Yes; Private & Dedicated support pinned model versions and custom images." Thoughts?
Ben Gomez: Good. For the calculator microcopy: main prompt -> "Estimate monthly cost for X requests/day (avg tokens per request)" Tooltip: "We assume baseline batching and prefix cache. Edit advanced settings to override." Example config: ```requests_per_day: 50000 avg_tokens: 60 batching_policy: standard cache: enabled```
Sam Lee: Love the short tooltip. For the results card copy: "Estimated monthly bill: $1,230 (incl. batching & cache)." CTA: "Get a tailored quote" (routes to AM_pool_2). Keep it action-forward.
Jordana Park: Webinar blurb draft: "Join our Launch Lab: Reduce LLM inference cost by 3-5x — live demo of batching, quantization, and our estimator. Wed 10AM PT." Registration CTA should include question: "Are you evaluating Dedicated or Private?" -> used to route lead.
Aisha Khan: Nice. A/B on tier names: Ravi propose Variant A (spec names): Core / Scale / Enterprise. Variant B (outcome): Prototype / Production / Mission-Critical. We’ll run site copy A/B at 50/50 for two weeks and measure sign-ups + estimator usage.
Ravi Patel: I'll prepare copy variations and short rationale for each for the roadmap doc. Also adding micro-FAQ line about benchmarking: "Our published benchmarks assume seq length 512 and GPU type A500/80GB; contact us for custom runs."
Ben Gomez: One more: marketing tweet/post blurb for launch: "New pricing calculator + webinar — See how Redwood reduces per-token cost in real workloads. Register: <shortlink>" Keep under 200 chars.
Sam Lee: I'll QA all responsive truncations and mobile view. Ping me when copy is in final doc.
marketing-bot: action_items: ["Ravi -> tier copy & FAQ bullets","Ben -> calculator copy + webinar blurb + shortlink","Sam -> mobile QA & tooltip visuals","Jordana -> routing rules & registration questions"]. Due: 2 days.
Aisha Khan: Awesome. Small ask — can someone draft a one-paragraph benchmark narrative we can use on the launch post? Need it by EOD tomorrow. Keep it concrete and numbers-first (e.g., 3x cost reduction on chat workloads).
Ravi Patel: I’ll take a stab and share a 1-paragraph draft in this thread by EOD.
Ben Gomez: I'll generate the shortlink and add UTM for campaign=pricing-launch.
Sam Lee: I'll start overlay QA and post screenshots in #marketing-assets when ready.
Jordana Park: I'll coordinate with ops to ensure the estimator leads get the correct tag and the CRM field 'evaluation_type' set from the registration question.
Aisha Khan: Thanks team. Report back here with final copy + assets. :rocket:
